title: Remove the id()-keyed de-duplication from DirtySetBuilder that made audit_mode runs diverge
summary: Discriminator on bare origin/main: 8 of 96 short trials diverged with the id() de-dup, 0 of 96 with address reuse made impossible; fix removes the identity registry (no retained references): 0 of 144 trials diverged after. get_frozen probed, no stale hit in 300 ticks. deterministic_execution.md audit_mode claim corrected; INFRA-421 added; regression test forces id() collisions and fails on the old code.
